training.title: Training
training.intro: Each run learns from the approved replies and the datasets chosen, and adds a new version. The version stores only what changed.

learns.title: What it learns from
learns.label: Approved replies
learns.what: Every reply that was corrected or approved in the chat and is still used for training counts.

views.label: Show
views.examplesNote: Each example is a conversation as it goes into training. The highlighted reply is the one the model learns.

form.title: Train a new version
form.intro: A run takes the approved replies and the chosen datasets and adds a version. Only one run trains at a time.
form.name: Name of the new version
form.nameHint: Optional. Without a name, the version shows only its number.

startsFrom.label: Start from
startsFrom.base: The base model has no earlier training. The new version learns only from the examples.
startsFrom.enhance: Enhancing {version} keeps what it learned and adds the new examples.

form.useCorrectionsHint: Replies corrected or approved in the chat. Approved replies: {count}
form.activate: Make it the active version when done
form.activateHint: Chat then uses the new version. An older version can be made active again.
form.expertChanged: Some expert settings are changed and still apply.
form.custom: Custom value: {value}. Set in Expert mode.
form.loadingPlan: Loading the settings for this machine

blocked.noReplies: There is nothing to learn from yet. Approve a reply in Chat or choose a dataset.
blocked.noSource: Turn on learning from the approved replies or choose a dataset.
blocked.settings: Some settings need a different value.

epochs.label: Passes over the examples
epochs.hint: How many times the model goes through all the examples. More passes learn more and can start to memorise.

rank.label: How much the model may change
rank.hint: A larger change can learn more. It needs more memory and disk space.

rate.label: How strongly it learns
rate.hint: A strong rate learns fast and can overshoot. A gentle rate is slow and steady.

expert.intro: Every setting a run takes. The defaults suit this machine and model.
expert.epochsHint: Passes over all the examples. Maximum steps overrides it.
expert.rankHint: Size of the add-on. A larger rank can learn more.
expert.maxStepsHint: Stops after this many steps. Empty runs every pass in full.
expert.maxSeqLenHint: Longer examples are skipped. Memory use grows with this.
expert.batchSizeHint: Examples processed together. A larger batch needs more memory.
expert.gradAccumHint: Batches collected before each update. The effective batch is the batch size times this.
expert.loraAlphaHint: Scales the effect of the add-on. Often twice the rank.
expert.loraDropoutHint: Share of the add-on skipped at random while training. 0 turns it off.
expert.rsloraHint: Scales by the square root of the rank. Keeps large ranks stable.
expert.biasesHint: Also changes the model's bias values. The version can then only be exported as merged weights.
expert.quantizeHint: Loads the base model compressed to 4 bits. Needs less memory. Quality drops slightly.
expert.checkpointingHint: Recomputes some work to save memory. Training is slower.

problem.limit: Enter a whole number of 1 or more.

verdict.fits: This machine has enough memory to train this model.
verdict.tight: Memory is tight. It may run out during training and shorten the examples.
verdict.too_large: This model is too large to train on this machine.
verdict.cpu_only: No GPU found. It will train on the processor, slowly.
verdict.unknown: It is not known whether this machine can train this model.

empty.title: No runs yet.
empty.write: Start training from the card above. Its progress shows here.
empty.read: A trainer or an administrator can start training.

stop.title: Stop this run?
stop.body: The run ends at its next step. Nothing it learned is saved.

remove.title: Remove this run?
remove.body: The run leaves the list. A version it made stays in the tree.

stage.queued: Waiting for its turn. One run trains at a time.
stage.oom_retry: Ran out of GPU memory. Trying again with shorter examples.

empty.title: No approved replies yet.
empty.body: Correct or approve a reply in Chat. It then appears here, and a run can learn from it.

examples.conversation: Conversation as it goes into training

run.oom: Ran out of GPU memory, so the examples were shortened to {length} tokens and training started again.

result.title: Result
result.done: Training is done and the version is saved.
result.size: {size}, which is {percent} of the full model
result.activeYes: It is now the active version.
result.stoppedBody: Nothing was saved from this run.

failure.no_examples: None of the approved replies could be used. They may be too long for the length limit or not readable.
failure.out_of_memory: The GPU ran out of memory, even with shorter examples. Choose a smaller rank, turn on 4-bit loading, or use a smaller model.
failure.load_failed: The model could not be loaded. Check that it finished downloading.
failure.training_parts_missing: The training parts are not installed. Install them with this command:
failure.trainer_crashed: Training stopped unexpectedly. Start the run again.
failure.interrupted: Mesbah restarted while this run was going. Start it again.
failure.bad_settings: These settings can't be used together. Change them and start again.

loss.title: Learning progress
loss.waiting: The chart starts after the first step.

live.too_early: Too early to tell. The loss needs a few more steps.
live.falling: Learning steadily. The loss fell from {first} to {latest}.
live.levelled_off: The loss has levelled off at {latest}. More steps won't add much.
live.rising: Getting worse. The loss rose to {latest}. Try a gentler learning strength.

done.too_early: Too few steps to tell how the loss moved. It ended at {latest}.
done.falling: The loss fell steadily, from {first} to {latest}.
done.levelled_off: The loss levelled off at {latest}. More steps would not add much.
done.rising: The loss rose by the end, to {latest}. Try a gentler learning strength.

chart.paceSummary: Learning rate and gradient norm by step

learned.title: Examples in this run
learned.skippedWhy: Skipped examples were too long for the length limit or could not be read.
learned.waiting: Shown once the examples are ready.

errors.nothing_to_learn: There are no approved replies to learn from yet. Correct or approve some in Chat first.
errors.base_model_not_ready: The base model hasn't finished downloading.
errors.wrong_parent: That version belongs to another project.
errors.run_still_going: Stop the run before removing it.
errors.dataset_not_ready: A chosen dataset isn't ready yet. Wait for its import to finish or choose another.

loss.explain: How far the model's answer is from the corrected one. Lower is better. It falls as the model learns.

epoch.explain: One full pass over all the examples. With two epochs the model sees every example twice.

learning_rate.explain: How big a step the model takes each time it learns. A high rate learns fast but can overshoot. A low rate is slow and steady.
